guardrails.artifact_use: candidate panel only; not benchmark, not silver labels, not import-ready labels

cofactor_shortcut_failure: Any heme-containing row becomes child-positive without naming peroxide, terminal O2, or oxygenase/reductase locus.
P450/heme oxygenase/electron-transfer heme rows collapse into classical peroxidase or catalase because heme is present.
Non-heme O2 enzymes route to heme because O2/oxygenase words or oxidoreductase folds are present.
External duplicate-hold rows are treated as new benchmark support because source chemistry is positive.
value_add_signal: Route m_csa:250 to heme peroxidase despite wrong Foldseek nearest neighbor and low sequence support.
Separate m_csa:124/714/735 terminal oxidases from peroxidases by heme-Cu/proton-channel/O2-to-water evidence.
Route P450 and heme oxygenase rows away from peroxidase/catalase despite heme and O2 language.
Reject non-heme Fe, copper, flavin, and luciferase oxygenases despite oxygenase/O2 vocabulary.
Preserve duplicate holds as controls rather than inflating external support.

non_claims: No labels, registries, ontologies, thresholds, imports, model outputs, production scoring, or model-training artifacts were changed.
This artifact does not authorize countable benchmark use.
Public source URLs are provenance pointers; no large downloads or coordinate fetches were performed.

panel_summary.primary_observation: The current parent is chemically over-broad: peroxidase/catalase, heme-copper terminal oxidase, P450/heme oxygenase, heme reductase/electron-transfer, and non-heme O2 enzymes need separate route evidence.

provenance_tier_definitions.tier_A_mcsa_curated: M-CSA/current registry row with curated mechanism/residue evidence.
provenance_tier_definitions.tier_B_external_curated: External row with exact/source-free active-site evidence plus duplicate-screen support; review-ready only.
provenance_tier_definitions.tier_C_external_incomplete: External/source row with credible chemistry and structure availability but missing duplicate, active-site, or child-stratum gates.
provenance_tier_definitions.tier_D_control_only: Duplicate hold, OOS, near-family hard negative, or leakage-control row.

scope.allowed_work: validation-panel design and source/evidence scouting only
scope.question: Whether broad v1 heme_peroxidase_oxidase hides incompatible heme chemistries and whether a router can separate peroxidase/catalase/oxidase/oxygenase boundaries.
